core_values: Universal public services as human rights
Solidarity across racial, gender, and national lines
Democratic planning of key economic sectors

economic_policy.taxation: Steeply progressive income tax with top marginal rates above 60%; wealth tax on net assets over $10 million; financial transaction tax; close offshore tax havens.
spending_priorities: Green industrial policy and jobs guarantee
economic_policy.trade: Fair trade over free trade; require labour rights, living wages, and environmental protections in all agreements; oppose investor-state dispute mechanisms.
economic_policy.regulation: Strong anti-monopoly enforcement; break up concentrated industries; mandate worker representation on corporate boards; cap executive-to-worker pay ratios.

social_policy.healthcare: Single-payer universal healthcare; abolish private insurance for covered services; nationalise pharmaceutical manufacturing for essential drugs.
social_policy.education: Free public education from pre-K through graduate school; cancel student debt; fund community schools as neighbourhood hubs; democratic school governance.
social_policy.housing: Treat housing as a right; massive public housing expansion; national rent control; community land trusts; ban corporate ownership of single-family homes.
social_policy.civil_rights: Intersectional justice framework; reparations study and programme; decriminalise poverty; abolish cash bail; expand labour rights to gig workers.
social_policy.immigration: Open and humane immigration; abolish immigration detention; full labour rights for undocumented workers; path to citizenship for all residents.

governance.decentralization: Democratic workplace governance; participatory budgeting at all levels; community control of police and public services.
governance.transparency: Public ownership of government data; ban revolving door between government and industry; publicly financed elections only.
governance.electoral_reform: Proportional representation; abolish the Senate filibuster; lower voting age to 16; same-day registration; make Election Day a holiday.

environment.climate_action: Green New Deal: rapid decarbonisation by 2035; treat climate as an emergency; just transition with guaranteed reemployment for displaced workers.
environment.energy: 100% publicly owned renewable energy; ban new fossil fuel extraction; retrofit all public buildings; free public transit.
environment.conservation: Environmental justice framework; prioritise pollution reduction in frontline communities; ban single-use plastics; regenerative agriculture subsidies.

security.defense: Cut military budget by 50%; close overseas bases; redirect savings to social programmes; end arms sales to authoritarian regimes.
security.law_enforcement: Defund and reimagine policing; invest in restorative justice, housing, and mental health as public safety; abolish private prisons.
security.foreign_policy: Anti-imperialist foreign policy; international solidarity with workers' movements; support self-determination of peoples; cancel Global South debt.
